back.showed: second broad elevation, pier on the viewer's right, same family as the front. Not the sheet back.

colour_root_cause: MeshStandard multiplied a pre-lit Imagine albedo by a sun that misses the front (front·sun about -0.84), and readRT stored linear bytes that the gate scored as sRGB. Lit material is now MeshBasic, toneMapped false. readRT sets SRGBColorSpace. Play Lab L* is 42.1.
